task_description: Build the dedicated, full-featured dark-theme 'Edit Service Item (Slides)' editor from the APPROVED design: additive model fields (ServiceItem.AudioAttachments, ServiceItem.StageTemplateId), pure Core helpers (ServiceItemAudio, SlideAutoAdvanceMap), the SlideServiceItemEditorWindow (XAML + code-behind + pickers), OperatorWindow entry-point routing for Slides items with remove/save/refresh wiring, and round-trip/migration/mirror tests. 'When complete' reuses the existing AutoAdvanceGoTo + GoToItemId (NO new field). Additive and backward-compatible; the 3 real service JSONs + demos must still load.
